plugins.name: pipedrive-sales
plugins.description: Pipedrive-native sales workflows: daily brief, pipeline brief, single-deal check, forecast, call prep, follow-up drafts, call logging, person and organization lookup, plus a front door for quick lookups and updates. Every write waits for your yes. Runs on the official Pipedrive MCP, vanilla Pipedrive only (no custom fields).
